discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed inflation as a solution to the horizon, flatness and monopole problems; Linde developed it into a workable theory (new and chaotic inflation). Mukhanov, with Chibisov, showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations stretched during inflation seed the density perturbations from which all cosmic structure grew, predicting a nearly scale-invariant, adiabatic, Gaussian spectrum with a slight red tilt. These predictions have since been confirmed with striking precision: COBE, WMAP, Planck, ACT and SPT measured the acoustic peaks, spatial flatness, adiabaticity, near-Gaussianity and a spectral index n_s below unity at more than eight standard deviations. Few theoretical ideas have turned speculation about the first instants of the universe into a quantitative, empirically tested framework. Inflation now underpins all of modern cosmology and motivates the ongoing search for primordial B-mode polarization.
